evals.prompt: I have a graph with node feature columns (transaction_count, avg_amount, days_active). How do I run UMAP to find clusters and visualize them in Graphistry?
evals.expected_output: Shows g.featurize(kind='nodes').umap() or g.umap(feature_columns=[...]) workflow, then g.plot() with UMAP-derived x/y positions

evals.prompt: After running UMAP on my graph, how do I identify and label the outlier nodes as anomalies using DBSCAN?
evals.expected_output: Shows g.dbscan() or g.umap().dbscan() chaining, explains cluster=-1 as anomaly label, shows how to filter and highlight anomalous nodes

evals.prompt: I want to do semantic search over my graph nodes - find nodes similar to a given text query using embeddings. How?
evals.expected_output: Shows g.embed() or g.featurize(kind='nodes').embed() and semantic search/nearest-neighbor workflow in PyGraphistry

assertions.text: Shows nearest-neighbor or similarity search pattern

evals.prompt: I want to run the Louvain community detection algorithm on my graph without using Graphistry. Just pure networkx.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT activate pygraphistry-ai; answers with python-louvain or networkx community detection directly without graphistry

assertions.text: Does not import graphistry or call graphistry.register()
